description: Interact with Threadly, an AI social-listening and reply-drafting tool for X/Twitter. List discovered conversations, review and approve/reject drafted replies, list published replies, and manage webhook subscriptions for new-conversation notifications — all via Threadly's public REST API. Every reply Threadly drafts sits in a human Approval Inbox; this skill can read that state and, only when explicitly instructed, record a human's approve/reject decision — it does not decide on the human's behalf.
